identity.name: TRUE COLORS LIMITED
identity.industry: Digital Textile Printing Ecosystem & Sustainable Manufacturing

summary.oneLiner: True Colors achieved 63% YoY revenue growth in H1FY26 driven by 450% surge in machine sales and capacity expansion, creating a compounding recurring revenue base from ink/paper; the shift from transactional sales to ecosystem lock-in via warranty-linked consumables and 35% govt subsidies is transforming market dynamics and positioning True Colors as India's only fully integrated digital textile platform.

one-line thesis: True Colors achieved 63% YoY revenue growth in H1FY26 driven by 450% surge in machine sales and capacity expansion, creating a compounding recurring revenue base from ink/paper; the shift from transactional sales to ecosystem lock-in via warranty-linked consumables and 35% govt subsidies is transforming market dynamics and positioning True Colors as India's only fully integrated digital textile platform.
financial scorecard: revenue: +63% YoY (INR151cr vs INR92.8cr); EBITDA/margin: 16% (stable range 13-16%); PAT (rptd): 10%; PAT (normalized): ~10% (no major distortions); order book: INR9cr (8 machines); net debt: zero (term loans fully repaid)
guidance: revenue growth: 30% YoY conservative; margin: EBITDA 13-16%, PAT 9-11%; order inflow: 90-100 machines by FY26 end; capex/commissioning: INR6-7cr for paper capacity expansion (completed), 1MW solar plant (next 2 months)
order book & pipeline: INR9 crore (8 machines pending delivery in H2FY26)
segment / subsidiary detail: Machine: INR38.4cr (26% of revenue, 60 units installed); Ink: INR40cr (+50% YoY); Paper: INR68cr (manufacturing division, 85-90% utilization); Fabric/Consumables: INR6cr (equivalent to prior full year); Sublimation paper capacity: doubled from 1cr to 2cr meters/month
growth verticals / optionality: Backward integration into ink manufacturing (under evaluation); export expansion with global certifications; technical textiles (pigment ink) adoption; 35% govt subsidy-driven MSME machine adoption
margins & cost dynamics: EBITDA margin 13-16% range maintained; machine sales dilute margin (thin margin) but drive recurring revenue; paper/ink margins stable at 13-17%; no raw material cost inflation cited
capex / expansion: INR6-7cr for paper capacity expansion (completed); INR1cr+ for 1MW solar rooftop plant (commissioning in next 2 months); no further capex announced
capital allocation: Zero net debt; focus on organic growth; fund raise flexibility retained; no dividend or buyback mentioned; capex funded internally
risks & watch-items: Dependence on machine sales volatility; potential competition from Chinese OEMs; ink quality lock-in risk if third-party inks gain warranty acceptance; subsidy policy changes
management quality / tone: Highly confident, visionary, transparent; emphasized ecosystem lock-in, recurring revenue, and generational shift in textile printing; strong focus on long-term value creation
non-obvious takeaways: Customer retention is not just about price — it's warranty voidance if non-True Colors ink is used, creating de facto exclusivity; 560 active machines already in field generating daily recurring revenue; 7-8% self-consumption of paper is strategic to ensure quality control and supply chain resilience
